label: Three omission scopes of giving, by derivation and finite controls
description: A placed diagnostic for 0050b6ed. It certifies the §56 omission table that was hand-checked only: individual omission, whole-actual-roster withholding with replacement, and giving-level total refraining (TOTAL_REFRAINING_1) are distinct and strictly ordered modal profiles of a source's giving; a necessarily productive source excludes the third and can permit the first two (the replacement frame witnesses both; Van Cleve's frame shows that it need not permit the second); a fixed giver gives each actual recipient wherever it exists (reading a fixed giver as a necessary manifestation is an open interpretive bridge). The replacement frame satisfies #1897's ActualAbsenceByWithholding while giving something at every world. Recipients are individuated by provenance with rigid beings; under role individuation (1cb16a7f) the replacement frame withholds nothing. Finite surrogates only.
